label: rejected
reviewer: blind fresh agent (renders + close-ups + gate report + rubric only)

evidence.V1: Front, three-quarter and silhouette read instantly as a single-bit axe (flared bearded blade, collar, banded grip, pommel), but the top view is just a gold disc plus a grey sliver and does not read as an axe; no correctness failure (A15 Y error 0.0, alignment offsets 0.0, both seats seated).
evidence.V2: Clear tiers: big = flared blade + long haft, medium = gold collar, upper ring and pommel, small = grip wrap bulges with thin dark-gold stripes and the haft end cap.
evidence.V3: Blade flare is confidently stylised, but the haft is long and pencil-thin (5.39 studs tall vs a ~1.9-stud head) so the whole reads more realistic-lanky than chunky-kit; partly exaggerated.
evidence.V4: Chamfers are present and catch light on the collar, rings, end cap, neck block and the blade rim; the blade rim bevel band is a consistent light strip along edge, beard and toe.
evidence.V5: Minor faceting: the pommel sphere shows a visibly polygonal lower outline in the grip close-up, and the neck-to-blade transition has a hard kinked facet line with a lighter wedge facet at the top in the edge close-up; no z-fighting or seams, steel neck enters the gold collar cleanly.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: one hue (teal) in dark haft / mid grip values, gold accent with a darker gold for grip stripes, steel greys for the head; colourways (crimson, shadow) swap only the hue and keep gold/steel intact.
evidence.V7: 1636 tris vs weapon target 2500 (ceiling 4000), under target.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material and smooth shading match the kit, but no ink-dark value appears anywhere and the hue only shows two clear values rather than three; blade rim bevel looks wider than the ~0.045 stud kit chamfer.
evidence.V9: Studio line is correct: Tool Handle, origin at grip point, Hull collision, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic.

artifacts: Pommel sphere has a visibly faceted (polygonal) lower outline in the grip close-up
Hard kinked facet line where the rectangular neck block transitions into the flat blade, with a lighter wedge facet at the top (edge close-up)
184 cross-shell overlaps reported (intentional collar/head interpenetration; not visible as z-fighting, but worth confirming no hidden faces flicker in Studio)
top_fixes: Thicken the haft (~1.3-1.5x) and/or shorten it slightly, or enlarge the head, so proportions read chunky-stylised rather than lanky
Add a third value of the hue and an ink-dark accent (e.g. darker teal under the collar/end cap or ink-dark grip stripes) to match the kit palette rule
Raise the pommel sphere segment count or chamfer it so its outline is round, and soften the neck-to-blade transition with a bevel/extra loop so the kink facet disappears
Give the blade some edge-on thickness variation (thicker spine near the neck tapering to the rim) so the top/edge view reads as an axe head rather than a flat sliver
Match the blade rim bevel width to the kit's ~0.045 stud chamfer
